description: Validates an Italian Codice Fiscale (tax code): 16 characters (individuals: format, check character, omocodia, date and place of birth) or 11 digits (companies and entities: same check as the Partita IVA). Formal check only: it does NOT say whether the code was issued or to whom (the limit is stated in the response, in `non_verificato`). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

codice_fiscale.description: The Codice Fiscale to validate (e.g. RSSMRA85T10A562S).

name: validate_codice_fiscale
title: Validate Codice Fiscale
